title: Aging curve: honestly not buildable here
headline_insight: Aging curves are not buildable from this data -- no birthdate or age column exists in any NBA table and only 3 season snapshots are on hand, so the honest move is to not pretend we have a curve.
what_it_means: Aging-curve methods need age-labeled player-seasons across many seasons (delta and GAM methods want thousands of paired seasons). This repo has 3 season snapshots (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) and no age field at all, so a curve cannot be honestly estimated. The codebase's own audit and an independent industry-analytics note both reach the same DEFER verdict.
how_to_read: The status field reads not_buildable; there is no chart to read here, the module is a documented gap rather than a result.
why_it_matters: Recording what cannot be built, and exactly why, is as much a part of the honest ledger as the analytics that can be built.
caveat: This is a data-availability limit, not a claim that aging effects do not exist; add age labels and more seasons and the module becomes testable.
